title: My Best Friend Countdown Ended 11 YEARS Ago ⏳
description:
Here, the cuff on your sleeve counts down the days to your best friend. Two strangers hit zero on a bus and couldn't stop laughing.

Mine hit zero eleven years ago, on my first morning at the plant nursery. The only other person there was Gus, and we've argued every day since.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
